versions.content: Invalid configuration of an array as RunnableEntityArgument Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00072, SRS_Rte_00029 The RTE Generator shall reject a configuration if • a RunnableEntityArgument is present AND • the ImplementationDataType of the RunnableEntityArgument resolves to an Array Implementation Data Type AND • the serverArgumentImplPolicy of the RunnableEntityArgument is not set to useArrayBaseType .
